name: burnt
meaning: MSG_KILL (0) with argument 0 (an explosion): Porky turns black (tint 0x1000, INST_F_TINT) and his next talk says the burnt line (0x45a30b)

name: burntLineSaid
meaning: the burnt line (class string 9, voice 0x41) has been said; it is said once (0x45a27e-0x45a28d)

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY ACTIVATIONBOX (record +0x00; an id list that must hold exactly one box, else state 5): Ralph's x/z inside it starts a cinematic (0x45a6d9, 0x459de0)

name: cinBox
meaning: PROPERTY CINBOX (+0x10; 0 unless exactly one box): Cine_Start's box (0x45a77d)

name: sheepBox
meaning: PROPERTY SHEEPBOX (+0x28; exactly one box, else state 5): Cine_Start's sheep box (0x45a72f)

name: cinWithSheep
meaning: PROPERTY CINWITHSHEEP (+0x1c) as a word (0x45a7ac): the cinematic played when Ralph arrives with a sheep

name: cinWithoutSheep
meaning: PROPERTY CINWITHOUTSHEEP (+0x14) as a word (0x45a7cd): the cinematic played when he arrives without one

name: state
meaning: PorkyLevel01 state (SetState 0x45a446): 0 waiting for Ralph in ACTIVATIONBOX, 1 lesson done, 2 with-sheep cinematic, 3 without-sheep cinematic, 4 saying a line, 5 disabled (a box property is missing), 6 question box open

name: cinWithSheepPlayed
meaning: the with-sheep cinematic has started; afterwards neither cinematic plays again (0x459e80, 0x459f4b)

name: cinWithoutSheepPlayed
meaning: the without-sheep cinematic has started; it plays once (0x459f3f)

name: cinWithSheepText
meaning: Text_GetClassString(CINWITHSHEEPTEXT +0x20): the with-sheep cinematic's text (0x45a81e)

name: cinWithoutSheepText
meaning: Text_GetClassString(CINWITHOUTSHEEPTEXT +0x18) (0x45a7f6)

name: withSheepText2
meaning: Text_GetClassString(WITHSHEEPTEXT2 +0x30) (0x45a86e); not read in this file

name: withoutSheepText2
meaning: Text_GetClassString(WITHOUTSHEEPTEXT2 +0x2c) (0x45a846); not read in this file

name: saladDelayMs
meaning: PROPERTY DISPLAYSALADMILLIS (+0x24) at load: the delay before the first lettuce appears during the with-sheep cinematic; then 500 ms between lettuces. Counts down by g_dtMs only while g_cinePlayer.wolfReady (0x459ca4); signed test jle 0x459ca2

name: sheep
meaning: the sheep (class 11 within 200 of Ralph) that started the with-sheep cinematic: sent msg 0x12 then, and msg 0x13 when the cinematic ends (0x459ec8, 0x45a392)

name: menuJustOpened
meaning: bit 0: set by the talk message, cleared at the end of every Update; blocks a second talk and the confirm press in the same frame (0x45a209, 0x45a06b, 0x45a162)

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: bit 1: Ralph was frozen with msg 0xE when the talk started; unfrozen with msg 0xF when the line or the box ends, cleared by msg 0xE back (0x45a220, 0x459d73, 0x45a1c1). Signed int bitfield (shl/sar)

name: unusedBits
meaning: the rest of the flag word; never read or written (it fills the int storage unit VC6 gives the two bitfields)

name: choicePages
meaning: the question box's node array (root + 3 choices + 1), built by Menu_BuildList (0x45a925)

name: choiceMenu
meaning: Menu record written by Menu_BuildList; its count (+0xec) sizes the box (0x45aa69)

name: curVoice
meaning: voice of the line being said (SetState argument 3; Dialogue_Say 0x459d52)

name: salads
meaning: the level's lettuces (Scenaric_FindByClass(3, .., 20) 0x459c0a), taken out of the world at load; a slot is zeroed once shown

name: saladPos
meaning: each lettuce's position when it was taken out (0x459c5b); ShowSalad puts it back there

name: saladCount
meaning: number of lettuces found (compared unsigned with jae 0x459c39; Update reads its low byte as a signed char, movsx 0x459cfc)

name: saladShowActive
meaning: 1 from the start of the with-sheep cinematic until every lettuce has been shown one by one

name: saladShowIndex
meaning: index of the last lettuce shown; -1 at the start (movsx byte 0x459cf2)

name: curText
meaning: line being said in state 4 (SetState argument 2)

name: questionBox
meaning: text = ASKTEXT, pages = &choicePages, list = &choiceMenu, rect sized to the longest line and centred in 512x240 (0x45a930-0x45ab43); drawn with Ui_DrawMenuBox in state 6

name: choiceTexts
meaning: Text_GetClassString(CHOICESTEXTS + i) (0x45a8d6), printed by the three choice handlers
